newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen mixed on new accounts day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen mixed on new accounts day.

text.p: Pakistani stocks are likely to remain mixed on Wednesday, the new accounts day, with genuine investors biding their time due to concerns about the economic outlook, dealers said.

"The index is likely to remain range-bounded today as investors remain on the sidelines before the budget (1997/98 July-June) due in June," dealer Rony Byramjee said. "Investors are cautious and only speculators are active."
On Tuesday, the index rose 3.19 points, or 0.21 percent, to end at 1,530.11. Losers led gainers 174 to 57 in a turnover of 40.25 million shares. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
